lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The second and third lines from the anterior terminate at approximately 50% torso depth. The final two lines on the posterior flank are truncated, appearing only as dorsal segments.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A low-density grouping of 3 distinct circular white spots is visible on the lower haunch, situated above the rear leg joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: The two lowest spots on the posterior haunch exhibit a horizontal alignment pattern.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns show a clear lyrate, spiral trajectory; they extend upward and outward from the frontal bone before curving inward and posteriorly at the apex.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The distance between terminal tips is approximately 1.5 times the combined pixel width of the horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping occupies approximately the top 8-10% of the total visible horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent white dorsal crest/fringe is visible along the spine. Distinct white markings are present on the lower jaw and facial region, along with white 'sock' markings above the black bands on the orange-tan lower limbs.
